name: aliexpress-israel-skills
description: AliExpress shopping skills for an Israel-based buyer: honest search that resolves true SKU prices behind anchored and bundle cards, real delivery promises to Israel (fast-lane filter), locale preference with drift guard (default EN/USD), Choice-first search, IL-only review filtering, shipping-lane evaluation, plug/voltage checks, and the $75 customs de-minimis across listings and the live cart. Exports findings and the cart to JSON/Markdown/PDF and, behind a graduated write ladder, adds to cart, reads the real checkout page, and places an order behind a confirmation gate. Drives the user's own browser; headless is a fallback.
